config.label: Optional TokenLab API base URL
config.description: Optional TokenLab API base URL. Defaults to https://api.tokenlab.sh.

config.label: Optional TokenLab API key
config.description: Optional TokenLab API key. Required for LLM inference, multimodal generation, async task, embedding, rerank, and translation tools.

config.label: Optional request timeout in milliseconds
config.description: Optional request timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 120000.

config.label: Optional generated tool profile: catalog, core (default), or full
config.description: Optional generated tool profile: catalog, core (default), or full.

config.label: Optional tool schema mode: portable, exact, or strict
config.description: Optional tool schema mode: portable, exact, or strict. Defaults to the selected profile's tested mode.

config.label: Optional maximum local upload size per file
config.description: Optional maximum local upload size per file. Defaults to 104857600 bytes.

config.label: Optional maximum response size returned inline
config.description: Optional maximum response size returned inline. Defaults to 2097152 bytes.

config.label: Optional local directory for response artifacts that are not returned inline
config.description: Optional local directory for response artifacts that are not returned inline.
